build_RayInterpolationRegularizer: build a RayInterpolationRegularizer instance with a system and config to interpolate rays using a blending network
review_RayInterpolationRegularizer_forwa: review the RayInterpolationRegularizer forward method that backprojects rays, looks up RGB values, and blends using cosine similarity
test_RayInterpolationRegularizer_loss: test the RayInterpolationRegularizer loss method that computes color loss between interpolated and ground truth RGB
summarize_RayInterpolationRegularizer_ge: summarize the get_depths method that generates randomized depth samples in linear or disparity space
run_RayInterpolationRegularizer_validati: run the RayInterpolationRegularizer validation method to produce interpolated RGB images from a batch of rays
